reason: Considered HOLD. Research was thin: web searches for the 11-20 drop returned mostly stale or undated articles and could not confirm the drivers of the week's selloff. Found only that NVDA reported a beat-and-raise on 11-17 (revenue about $115.8B, Q4 guide about $130B) but the stock rose only about 2.6 to 4 percent after hours amid a broader AI and chip selloff. The Round 2 book is diversified quality mega-caps with 16 percent cash, NVDA already trimmed to 8 percent with a stop at -25 percent, and no leg is near a stop. Selling into a falling tape without a confirmed reason would add churn cost (2bps per side plus SEC/TAF) and realize losses on names whose theses are intact. Holding preserves the 16 percent cash as dry powder for a later entry.
